provenance.pipeline: satsuki v1 (v1.0.1 editorial re-edit: usage-note reshaping corpus-wide, lane discrimination for same-surface families, against prompts/style.md)

patterns.usage_note: Announces the speaker's evaluation ahead of the fact that caused it: an emotion word plus ことに opens the sentence (嬉しいことに, 困ったことに, ありがたいことに). The slot takes emotive i-adjectives, た-forms of feeling verbs, and na-adjectives through な (妙なことに), not plain events; ことには is a slightly heavier variant. The contracted ことにゃ is dialect-flavoured and in practice attaches to the conditional 〜ないことには frame instead.

examples.ruby: 嬉[うれ]しいことに、探[さが]していた本[ほん]が古本屋[ふるほんや]で見[み]つかった。
examples.english: To my delight, the book I'd been hunting for turned up in a used bookshop.

examples.ruby: 困[こま]ったことに、鍵[かぎ]をどこに置[お]いたか思[おも]い出[だ]せない。
examples.english: Annoyingly, I can't remember where I put the keys.

examples.ruby: ありがたいことに、隣[となり]の人[ひと]が傘[かさ]に入[い]れてくれた。
examples.english: Mercifully, the person next to me let me under their umbrella.
